prompt.en: Spot the error in this study-table row: 'Retain the certificate or a copy at the station; if an inspector asks, produce the original within 48 hours.' Which correction best fixes the row?

text.en: Keep the certificate retention rule separate from the inspector-production rule: the copy wording belongs to the inspector request, and the 48-hour response may use the certificate or a copy.
Replace both duties with a reminder to keep the certificate on your person whenever you operate away from home.
Leave the copy-at-station wording, but change 48 hours to one week so the inspection row is less strict.
Delete the retention row entirely because a lifetime certificate has no continuing record duties.

explanation.en: The lesson keeps two nearby facts from being blended: certificate retention is a station/address duty, while the certificate-or-copy wording and the 48-hour clock belong to an inspector request.

prompt.en: Which accommodation note is NOT true as a summary of the lesson?

text.en: An oral delivery may be used in stated situations instead of assuming every candidate must use the same written format.
A Morse sending accommodation can use spoken Morse-code sounds when the bank's stated condition applies.
Medical evidence may be requested before an accommodation is provided.
Interpreter accompaniment is the supported fix when a candidate has insufficient English or French.

explanation.en: The other notes preserve true accommodation rows from the lesson. The interpreter note is the exception: the lesson separates an oral-examination possibility from interpreter accompaniment.

prompt.en: A fee spreadsheet uses one formula: 'If it mentions certificates, call signs, or exams, enter Free.' What problem will this create?

text.en: It will hide the paid voluntary call-sign-change row and blur accredited-examiner cost recovery with no-charge ISED office exams.
It will make first-certificate issue look paid even though the lesson places that row in the no-charge group.
It will correctly combine every fee row because all certificate-related services use one price rule.
It will affect only accommodation notes and leave call-sign rows unchanged.

explanation.en: Fee rows have to remain tied to the exact service. A universal formula would predict the wrong result for voluntary call-sign changes and would mix the two examination settings.
